faqs.a:
(a)
LSL shall be prohibited for use as service line material as of the effective date
               of this article. All LSL must be identified and replaced in full by December 31, 2026.
               Penalties for non-compliance will be assessed after December 31, 2026. Partial replacement
               of LSL is not permitted.
(b)
No new water service connections will be permitted to a property with an LSL. A new
               service line must be installed to any rebuilt structure if existing services do not
               meet the engineering standards.
(
Ord. No. 4869
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
